properties.description: One shared server, two worktrees on branches A and B, a session in each. Session A changes a registered file and accepts its new checksum, records a ChangeEvent for its code, and also adds a requirement. Export B. PASS: B's export carries the requirement (intent is live) and does NOT carry A's checksum, ChangeEvent or artifact status. B's export passes the coherence gate against B's tree. Reproduces fact:the-live-graph-does-not-branch-so-two-open-prs-collide, where a sibling's checksums failed the gate seven-plus times. Must fail on today's build before it is trusted.
properties.name: A checksum accepted on one branch never appears in another branch's export, while intent written on it does
